appuyez: the TAP prompt (end screens, rewards; 'APPUYEZ' in the French client)
appuyez_centre: the TAP prompt in the middle of the screen
auto_mot: the word AUTO of the auto button in battle
auto_off: the AUTO button when it is switched off
auto_on: the AUTO button when it is switched on
autoselect_texte: the 'Auto select' text on the team screen
bille_dragon_ball: a Dragon Ball icon on a battle card
btn_regler: the 'Set' / confirm button of the team
btn_terminer: the 'Finish' button (end of an equipment awakening)
criteres_titre: the title of the priority-criteria screen
croix: the X that closes a window
dialogue_auto: the 'Auto' button of dialogues (top of the screen)
dialogue_journal: the 'Log' button of dialogues (top of the screen)
dissolution_titre: the title of the 'player search interrupted' pop-up
erreur_texte: the error message text (e.g. player search failed)
gain_recomp_titre: the title of the reward screen
gen_suivant_sombre: the 'Next' button on a dark background
logo_assaut_raid: the 'Raid Boss Assault' banner in the events list
menu_histoire: the 'Story' entry of the main menu
menu_tuile_histoire: the 'Story' tile inside the opened menu
modif_perso_titre: the title of the character-edit screen
popup_bonus_leader_titre: the title of the 'Check Leader Bonuses' pop-up
popup_defi_histoire_titre: the title of the 'Confirm story challenge' pop-up
popup_echec_titre: the title of the failure pop-up
popup_moins_trois: the pop-up warning that fewer than 3 characters are selected
popup_suite: the confirm button of a pop-up
popup_titre: the title of an information pop-up
raid_combat_icone: the 'list' icon at the top during a raid battle (used as a reference point)
raid_equipe_icone: the team icon of the raid screen
raid_pret: the 'Ready' button of the raid lobby
rising_rush_equipe: the Rising Rush icon on the team screen
salon_raid_titre: the title of the raid lobby
tuto_fermer: the 'Close' button of a full-screen tutorial
tuto_suivant: the 'Next' button of a full-screen tutorial
visionner_texte: the 'Watch' (skip/replay option) text next to its checkbox
